item.title: World leaders gather at United Nations this week
item.description: António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.

item.title: German chancellor stays course after party loses state elections
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz called the night a "disaster" for the political center but said he would continue with his plans.

item.title: Iowa farm shifts from pig slaughter to growing mushrooms
item.description: Iowa supplies nearly a third of U.S. pork. One family is transitioning from pigs to specialty mushrooms, aiming for a more sustainable operation.
